artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan implementing the RETAIN trans_refl verdict: four label-level congruence theorems in PlusWitnessFamily/Incompleteness.lean, their C2 axiom pins, four theorem-index rows, and the retention decision on three prose surfaces.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, landing one new pinned theorem is a four-surface coupled edit, not a one-file edit, and the coupling is directional: (1) the declaration's own /-- docstring must carry a `Paper:` line (the anchor, or the literal em-dash plus a one-clause reason) because check-module-invariants.sh's C15 second assertion asserts the row-to-declaration round trip; (2) scripts/check-module-invariants.sh needs BOTH a `#print axioms <fully-qualified-name>` probe line and a matching expected-output baseline line, in the same order, with the axiom value READ OFF the probe output rather than typed (the theorem-index Axioms column is generated from these baselines); (3) only then may the docs/theorem-index.md row land, because C36a asserts every ledger row is pinned by C2 or C14 and goes red on a row whose baseline is missing; (4) any commit touching a .lean file must also stage a regenerated typst/generated/status.typ, because the pre-commit gate runs typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only (repair with typst-sync-check.sh --fix, which needs a built library and never runs git add). A plan that puts the ledger row before the baseline row, or that omits status.typ from its file scope, produces a predictable red or an undeclared scope extension.
